comparison: The previous class candidate index versus selection of the least frequent required class. Both arms use identical dependencies, parser, HIR, matcher, and benchmark sources. The existing nine cases and one new compound class case are measured separately.
changes: Count all direct classes of the last local relative selector.
Build contiguous candidate ranges only for classes selected by at least one selector.
Start matching from the smallest retained range.
Keep dynamic class and spread candidates for every class selector.
Share selector class traversal between registration, selection, and matching.
Skip index selection when the file has no compound classes.

candidate_defect_control.failure: incorrectly has an unused selector.

validation.structure: 812 source files measured; maximum 1306 lines; default limit 600

limitations.hardware_cache_misses: UNMEASURED: cache misses are Cachegrind simulations, not hardware events.
limitations.peak_resident_memory: UNMEASURED: allocated bytes count requests, not resident memory.
limitations.official_svelte_semantic_phase: UNMEASURED: there is no matching public phase API. Fixture oracle version: 5.57.1.
limitations.old_rsvelte_semantic_phase: UNMEASURED: main has no equivalent phase API. Main commit: 5ed8ea3a3401b9fbbe780d3b18d6f90073291d6b.
limitations.workload_scope: Performance results are for synthetic inputs, not whole compiler throughput. Hardware and cache counters include process setup. Allocation counters cover the warmed phase loop.
limitations.selection_metadata: Each bucket stores a selection flag. Basic cases allocate 160 additional requested bytes per nine-document round. Their allocation count does not change.
limitations.other_phases: UNMEASURED: resolution and expression evaluation implementations were not changed.

simd: No handwritten intrinsics were added. This change reduces the number of elements passed to the CSS matcher.
build_validation: Linux and macOS allocation counts match exactly for both workloads and both arms. The frozen helper differs from the formatted workspace helper only in rustfmt line breaks; formatting both frozen helpers produces the exact workspace file.
measurement_validation: The first basic CPU run overlapped the restored control build and was discarded. The initial implementation also had extra basic-case work; measurements before adding the fast path are preserved separately and discarded. Final CPU runs start after builds and cache measurements finish.
